title: Weekly Puzzle #60 – What's a Mind Goblin?
selftext:
Please put proposed solutions behind spoiler markup (> and ! at start, then ! and < at end).

Huge thanks to the folks on the [Unofficial Discord's](https://discord.com/invite/botc) [puzzle channel](https://discord.com/channels/569683781800296501/854891541969109033) for their help with playtesting!

[Previous weekly puzzles are archived here.](https://notquitetangible.blogspot.com/2024/11/clocktower-puzzle-archive.html)

Finally, I've put out a [survey asking for feedback on the weekly puzzle series](https://forms.gle/ate2NJcQTfPgLSev5). If you have would like to fill it in and haven't done so already, I'd be very grateful for your views!
